subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: The system shall treat the repository memory as the authoritative source of a draft-born feature's PRD and tech spec and require no document source for them.
rationale: The memory gate must accept native contracts (brainstorm:feature-draft#F-1)
fit_criterion: A draft-born fixture in which a requirement written in memory is served by a decision written in memory passes every required check, with zero PRD or design document sources.
